verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GPU acceleration for Metal, NVIDIA, AMD and Vulkan, and CPU-only inference. Nothing documents splitting a model's layers between GPU and CPU, partial offload controls, or running models larger than available VRAM. GPU support alone is an adjacent capability, and the community report of mostly-CPU processing on an 8GB-VRAM laptop does not show deliberate hybrid offload.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
